how_to: Paste a public IG/FB post URL, set active=true. Comment BODIES need tokens (META_IG_TOKEN + media_id for IG; META_FB_PAGE_TOKEN + post_id for FB). Without tokens the tracker only records lightweight title context. Get IDs: IG media via your hashtag-search matches, FB post via Page feed.
